overview: MBBS in Nepal offers high quality medical education, advanced clinical training in affiliated government hospitals, and globally recognized medical degrees.

faq.question: Is NEET mandatory for MBBS in Nepal?
faq.answer: Yes, qualifying NEET in the year of admission or preceding two years is mandatory as per NMC guidelines.

faq.question: Is the degree from Nepal valid in India?
faq.answer: Yes, all our partner medical universities comply fully with NMC gazette guidelines, making graduates eligible for the NExT/FMGE exam.
